---
title: "Roadmap and Current Status"
---

## Current status

| Surface | State |
|---|---|
| Documentation and public contracts | Integrated Phase-1 scaffold |
| Installable/importable package and version metadata | Implemented, CI-validated, and integrated |
| `scgsim.palace` | Planned; not implemented |
| `scgsim.aedt` | Planned; not implemented |
| Common run/handoff and profiles | Planned; not implemented |
| Unified reports | Planned; not implemented |
| Notebook interfaces | Planned; not implemented |

The current implementation provides only package/version metadata and build/CI
packaging checks: Python `~=3.12.0`,
`scgsim.__version__ == "0.1.0.dev0"`, and no runtime dependencies. This site
therefore does not provide solver or execution instructions yet.

## Near term

1. Define the common artifact, profile, receipt, and handoff models.
2. Implement Palace Electrostatic and Eigenmode, emphasizing Surface EPR.
3. Implement version-locked PyAEDT paths for HFSS Eigenmode, HFSS Driven
   Modal/Terminal, Q3D, and Q2D.
4. Add notebook implementations and Plotly reports only as real APIs become
   available.

## Later

- Palace Driven
- Palace Magnetostatic

Meep remains excluded.
